section_summary: This section contains the concluding portion (entries from 'M' through 'Z') of an alphabetical index of Japanese laws, statutes, and ordinances enacted, amended, or repealed primarily between 1946 and late 1948 during the Allied Occupation of Japan. Each entry lists the title of the legislation, the law number, and the corresponding Official Gazette issue number and publication date. Major subjects covered include mariners, medical and public health legislation, national monopolies, government organization, public service, police, postal services, railways, special account laws, and comprehensive post-war tax reforms.

subfiles.about: An alphabetical reference index covering Japanese laws, statutes, and ordinances from letters M through Z enacted, revised, or repealed during the post-World War II Allied Occupation.
subfiles.summary: This document constitutes the final portion (letters M through Z) of a comprehensive alphabetical catalogue of Japanese legislation enacted, amended, or repealed between 1946 and late 1948 under the Allied Occupation. For each statute, the index provides the law title, law number, and the corresponding Japanese Official Gazette issue number and publication date. Key legal categories indexed include national and local tax laws, special account financial legislation, public procurators and police administration, postal and telecommunication services, national railways, maritime affairs, and the termination of zaibatsu family control.
subfiles.title: Index of Japanese Laws, Statutes, and Ordinances (M to Z)
